purpose: Internal editorial evidence matrix; reviewed public copy is maintained separately in content/ecosystem. No live factory missions were executed for this website research.
method: GitHub API default-branch commit and actual releases, isolated checkout of release where available otherwise exact remote main; repository README, security, setup, locks, implementations, tests, CI definitions, media manifests and retained verification evidence. Test results below are source-reported unless explicitly identified as website checks.

audience.summary: Developers preparing locally reviewed Node HTTP APIs, optional SQLite and static browser interfaces from a software mission; single trusted operator.

input.summary: Mission text plus an optional reviewed and sealed JSON software pack. Packs define requirements, allowed files and bounded API/browser tests as data; issue tracker is default, converter and notes are examples.

roles.summary: Commander interprets mission; architect scopes work; backend and frontend workers propose files concurrently; independent reviewer gates corrections; separate release reviewer examines the exact candidate. Read-only observer has no execution authority.

execution.summary: Node controller invokes pinned native Kujo Dispatch; tool-free Codex proposals enter allowlisted files. Trusted Workcell adapter executes generated code and API/browser checks in rootless containers. npm run factory -- run factory/mission.txt starts live work.

outputs.summary: Locally approved build only after release verification; source, frozen pack, reports and audit/export bundle. Export schema is kujo.factory.export/v1. Examples are untrusted smoke fixtures, not current approval.

evidence.summary: Run journal, worker proposals, rejected attempts, native Dispatch and Workcell evidence, API/browser results and exact source/harness/pack hashes; read-only Factory Floor and replay.

review.summary: Independent model review plus trusted acceptance checks, separate release review and repeated source-bound gates. Human reviews the software pack before sealing and reviews intended deployment separately. Source identity does not establish correctness or test completeness.

boundaries.summary: Rootless Docker with seccomp, read-only root, no outside network, scoped mounts, process/memory/deadline limits. Provider home, Docker socket and host evidence are not mounted. Nested Chromium sandbox unavailable inside qualified outer Workcell; no kernel-exploit guarantee.

dependencies.summary: Kujo runtime 1.9.0, Codex 0.144.4, AJV 8.20.0 and ajv-formats 3.0.1; exact Dispatch, Workcell and kujo-agents commits in source lock. No shipped Spec/Eval/ShipCheck/RunLedger/Casefile integration in this release.

demo.summary: Canonical narrated issue-tracker demonstration is historical Agent City extraction, predates software packs, and does not qualify the standalone release. SHA-256 4046393dc1e7c836ee8b944a6006ab81c8ea28aeae1c9a8a387581104ff0288e.

setup.summary: Git, Node >=26.12.1 <27, Codex account and local rootless Docker/seccomp. npm ci; npm run setup; npm run login; configure rootless engine; npm run image:build; npm run doctor; npm run verify; npm run smoke; npm start. Floor port 4380. Linux/WSL intended but live native Linux/ARM/WSL not qualified; recorded live engine qualification is macOS/Colima.

limitations.summary: Local single operator only; no hosted multi-tenant service, unattended crash recovery or deployment qualification. Future ecosystem integration work in feature branches is outside published 0.1.0. Current public main and release match at research time.

relationships.summary: Standalone software-production system; no universal factory controller. Product Launch separately pins a newer Software Factory evidence-verifier revision; that is not a feature of this published baseline.

factories.name: VideoOps Factory
factories.release_status: Default-branch source preview; no published GitHub release found

audience.summary: Small teams creating screenshot-led product launch clips from sourced facts and registered media.

input.summary: kujo.videoops.brief/v1 JSON: request, facts with sources, CTA, registered asset IDs; 1920×1080 or 1080×1920, 30fps, 3–60 seconds, silent. Operator registers trusted assets with provenance, rights and SHA-256.

roles.summary: Producer validates scope; Creative Director proposes timed plan; Asset Scout checks supplied provenance; Media Generator records NOT_REQUIRED for silent registered assets; HyperFrames Editor reviews plan; Video Critic reviews technical evidence. Calls are sequential.

execution.summary: Canonical videoops-production initializer; tool-free Codex proposals; trusted compiler creates HyperFrames scenes, checks and renders; canonical Python review tool records exact-candidate status. npm run factory -- run examples/launch-brief.json.

outputs.summary: output/draft.mp4, editable production/hyperframes project, metadata, frames, logs, role proposals and handoffs. Landscape and portrait examples are intentionally silent 12-second clips.

evidence.summary: State timestamps/elapsed time, JSONL events, kujo.handoff/v1 records, registered file hashes, metadata/technical checks, exact candidate SHA and videoops-review-decision/v1 ledger.

review.summary: Successful run stops at REVIEW_INCOMPLETE. Full visual playback and listening (including intentional silence) required by capable reviewer; local record/promote commands bind exact SHA. Rendering, contact sheets and model statements do not provide perceptual approval.

boundaries.summary: Tools/apps/web disabled for private Codex proposals; trusted renderer accepts validated data, not model HTML/JS. Loopback read-only floor. Registered codecs/media remain trusted host operations; this factory does not inherit Workcell isolation.

dependencies.summary: Kujo 1.9.0, Codex 0.144.4, GSAP 3.14.2, HyperFrames 0.9.40, Undici override 7.30.2; kujo-agents and kujo-workflows pinned sources; Python kujo-agents-videoops 0.3.0 with exact requirements. Retired kujo-videoops is historical, not a dependency.

demo.summary: Canonical narrated showcase uses actual floor/review stills and example renders from distinct recorded runs. Technical PASS; full listening not attested; REVIEW_INCOMPLETE. Separate authorized Siren demo does not make automatic narration part of silent runner.

setup.summary: macOS/Linux; Git, Node >=26.12.1 <27, Python 3.10+, FFmpeg/ffprobe 6+ with libx264/AAC, Codex account; browser download for render and libatomic1 on minimal Ubuntu. npm ci; setup; login; doctor; verify; npm start. Floor 4381. Model usage is separate from setup; no paid media generation on silent route.

limitations.summary: Three to five template scenes and final Kujo bumper; no general footage timeline, automatic narrated campaigns, arbitrary remote assets, automatic editor repair loop or publication. Failed runs require a new run; no mid-render resume.

relationships.summary: Standalone factory; Product Launch consumes pinned tools via a coordinator adapter. Canonical VideoOps tools live in kujo-agents, not retired kujo-videoops.

relationships.usage: Pinned role contracts, media service, audio QA and exact-candidate review CLI/Python tools.

factories.name: Publishing House Factory
factories.release_status: Default-branch source preview; no published GitHub release found

audience.summary: Editorial teams producing a reviewable article and adaptations from supplied source material.

input.summary: Brief schema kujo.publishing-house-factory.brief/v1 with title/audience/objective/voice/constraints and 1–10 UTF-8 source files inside brief directory; each <=100 KB, brief <=64 KB; HTTPS URLs are provenance, not remote retrieval.

roles.summary: Commissioning Editor proposes angle/outline; Standards & Evidence Editor maps claims and separately reviews article; Technical Editor/Writer drafts/revises; Franchise & Adaptation Editor creates newsletter, three social posts and landing copy; Copy Chief reviews adaptations. Production code packages records.

execution.summary: Canonical Publishing House Operator owns phases, leases, retries/checkpoints and approval pause. Python adapter calls Codex directly for sequential tool-free proposals and allowlisted Kujo tool commands. Text-only asset stage runs no media generator.

outputs.summary: Article and newsletter Markdown/JSON, exactly three social drafts, escaped landing HTML, retained source packet and versioned package manifest; local six-preview Factory Floor.

evidence.summary: Source snapshots and hashes; exact-excerpt claim mapping in Dossier; request/proposal pairs; BluePencil reviews; GalleyPack version/revision lineage and frozen manifest; VersionSeal request.

review.summary: Separate writer/reviewer calls, at most two article revisions and two adaptation revisions. Excerpt presence is observed support, not truth. Model pass ends at approval_required/AWAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW; human must inspect exact package.

boundaries.summary: No model code execution, browse or general tools; private read-only Codex proposals, regular confined source files, escaped HTML and loopback read-only viewer. Source text goes to model provider. No Workcell sandbox or publication credentials.

dependencies.summary: Kujo 1.9.0 and Codex 0.144.4; exact pinned canonical operator/roles and StoryDesk, Dossier, GalleyPack, BluePencil, VersionSeal. Dispatch and Agents SDK satisfy installed operator layout but do not run this adapter’s workers. PressWire initialized for compatibility; no publication effects.

demo.summary: Recorded live campaign and narrated canonical demo; inspect source/transition/playback verification. These are recorded evidence, not new work or campaign publication approval.

setup.summary: macOS/Linux/compatible WSL, Git, Python 3.10+, Node >=26.12.1 <27 and Codex account. npm ci; npm run setup; npm run login; npm run doctor; npm run verify; npm start. Run examples/videoops-launch.json in another terminal. Floor 4382. No Docker/FFmpeg/database needed.

limitations.summary: One fixed text campaign contract; no source research, media production or publication destinations. No approval/publish CLI, and direct publication phases rejected. Resume preserves completed matching artifacts; changed input or exhausted revisions require new run.

relationships.summary: Standalone editorial system coordinated by canonical operator. Product Launch invokes this factory for copy; Software and VideoOps remain independent.

factories.name: WebOps Factory
factories.release_status: Default-branch source preview; no published GitHub release found

audience.summary: Owners of bounded static exports needing scoped metadata, image-alternative and internal-link fixes on a disposable copy.

input.summary: JSON title/site/objective; static site relative to mission. At most 120 files and 8,000,000 bytes; worker context 150 KB. HTML/CSS/SVG/common images/text/XML allowed. Scripts, event handlers, frames, symlinks and active embeds rejected; hidden files/node_modules excluded.

roles.summary: Metadata Auditor owns missing/empty title and description; Link Health Auditor owns broken local file destinations; Accessibility Auditor supplies missing alt attributes; Site QA Operator independently reviews exact patch. Sequential tool-free calls.

execution.summary: Snapshot original, deterministic HTML audit, SiteProbe crawl/verify and Lens check; validate values, repair candidate copy, repeat checks, independent model review and package. --fixture supplies fixed proposals but real browser/crawl tools; --live uses Codex.

outputs.summary: before/ snapshot, candidate/ repaired copy, before/after findings, proposals/ and requests/, patches/repairs.diff, evidence/ SiteProbe/Lens output and package.json.

evidence.summary: Original byte comparison, exact source diff, before/after homepage desktop/mobile screenshots, crawl/browser/accessibility/link reports, worker values and reasons, independent review, manifest file hashes.

review.summary: Zero supported findings, passing final Lens threshold and passing independent review required for approval_required package. Broader crawl warnings retained. Human reviews patch/candidate before separate release process.

boundaries.summary: Workers cannot submit commands, markup, external targets or new repair types. Original never modified; preview CSP blocks scripts and network effects. Local floor read-only; manifest integrity is not a signature or malicious-host defense.

dependencies.summary: Kujo 1.9.0, Codex 0.144.4, Playwright 1.61.1; exact SiteProbe, Lens, kujo-agents and kujo-workflows commits. Canonical finding-to-fix PROPOSE contract informs adapter; production mutation step is not invoked.

demo.summary: Canonical narrated video shows exported recorded live run, not real-time execution. Media REVIEW_INCOMPLETE because listening not attested. npm run demo imports verified checked-in record without new model work.

setup.summary: macOS/Linux/compatible WSL; Git, Python 3.10+, Node >=26.12.1 <27, Codex for live mode. npm ci; setup; login; doctor; npm run factory -- run examples/studio.json --live; npm start. Linux may need npx playwright install-deps chromium. Floor 4383.

limitations.summary: Only four repair operations; no full WCAG/SEO certification, external link health, fragments, rankings/analytics, JavaScript sites, frameworks, authenticated crawling, retry/resume, source mutation or deployment. Static audit covers imported HTML; Lens checks homepage desktop/mobile.

relationships.summary: Standalone bounded adapter using SiteProbe/Lens; Product Launch consumes website candidate and browser evidence. Other factories are related, not runtime parents.

audience.summary: Product teams preparing consistent editorial, website and video deliverables from existing product evidence.

input.summary: kujo.product-launch.brief/v1: captured text sources with HTTPS provenance, audience/objective/voice/constraints, software-export or webops-package evidence, up to three PNG/JPEG product visuals with rights; silent video default, narration separate.

roles.summary: Five stations: Source evidence verifies existing package; Publishing House commissions/writes/reviews/adapts; WebOps inspects bounded landing repairs; VideoOps plans/compiles/renders/checks; Launch review collects versions and awaits human approval. Uses child roles rather than a new universal worker team.

execution.summary: Python coordinator freezes brief/evidence, invokes pinned child adapters, constructs static landing page from escaped editorial data and passes checked screenshots/facts to VideoOps. Software adapter invokes evidence.mjs verify only, never application construction.

outputs.summary: Local package with article, newsletter, three social posts, landing website, MP4, editable composition and underlying evidence. Export strips private homes and omits local approval.

evidence.summary: kujo.product-launch.handoff/v1 records input hashes, factory revisions, output inventory and prior dependency hashes. Exact package manifest and approval checks detect edited, added or deleted files. Recorded example includes 200 packaged files.

review.summary: Technical/model gates remain child-specific. Completed handoffs reused only with matching bytes; changed input needs new version, invalidates downstream review. Human reads every deliverable and plays full video before exact-hash local approve command; no publication authority.

boundaries.summary: Local trusted single operator; confined source paths and trusted pinned child execution, no arbitrary repository builds. Loopback read-only floor; generated previews block scripts/external assets/forms. Sources sent to configured model. Paid speech requires exact authorization and budget.

dependencies.summary: Pinned Publishing House, WebOps and VideoOps factories plus newer Software Factory evidence-verifier commit 259aff26e3ca627873eec6b40a89d6942b039d7c (not public Software 0.1.0). Direct npm Codex 0.144.4 and Playwright 1.61.1; child locks determine inherited tools.

demo.summary: Approved v0.1.0 coordinator demo: releases/download/v0.1.0/launch.mp4; 31.6s, 1920×1080, 30fps; SHA 60102b8d687173399387df3cd4bb1f4e37446538ef7705cabc524e94dc28fa45. Owner presentation approval recorded in release notes; raw technical ledger still REVIEW_INCOMPLETE and no independent listening attestation. Underlying example campaign remains unapproved.

Floor 4384.
